text: Most problems that wreck you... were once small enough to fix in five minutes.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Rewind a friendship. Month six... you're basically strangers.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Month two... the replies got shorter. Nobody said a word.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Week one... a cancelled plan. A joke that landed wrong. One honest message would have fixed it.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: In fifteen thirteen, Machiavelli explained this trap... with a doctor's rule.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: He wrote... in the beginning of the malady it is easy to cure but difficult to detect... but in the course of time... it becomes easy to detect but difficult to cure.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: While a problem is cheap... it's invisible. Once everyone sees it... it's expensive.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: In essence... he praised the Romans for spotting trouble early... and dealing with it at once.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The real skill isn't fixing big problems. It's acting on small ones... while it still feels silly.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Tonight, pick one thing you keep calling fine... a friend, a bill, that noise in your car... give it five minutes.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: What small thing are you ignoring? One word, below.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz... and catch it early.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
